comparison.objective: Remove an orbital replacement unit, stow it after a 90-degree reorientation, and install a spare.
comparison.physical_skill: Extraction, reorientation, constrained-slot placement, and bay insertion.
comparison.success_condition: Red unit is in the return slot at the required orientation and grey spare is seated in the vacated bay; explicit tolerances are absent.
comparison.reason: Module swapping and constrained insertion do not exercise hammer-and-mandrel fracture or loose-fragment search and containment.
